scripts.build: uv build && bun run --cwd packages/node build && bun run --cwd packages/gateway build
scripts.test: uv run --locked pytest && bun run --cwd packages/node test && bun run --cwd packages/gateway test
scripts.test:e2e: echo "Run PostgreSQL integration tests through the CI workflow or with POLICYSTRATA_RUN_DB_TESTS=1"
scripts.typecheck: uv run --locked mypy src && bun run --cwd packages/node build && bun run --cwd packages/gateway build
scripts.validate: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.validate:full: bun run validate && bun run build && bun run test:e2e
